text.en: This Order may be cited as the Halal Certificate and Halal Label (Amendment) Order, 2008 and shall commence on the same date as the Halal· and Halal Label Order, 2005 (S 39/05), in this Order referred to as the of section 14 of S 39/05.
Section 14 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection ll!(d}, by deleting "District-General" and by substituting "Director-General" therefor. of section 23.
Section 23 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection 11), by deleting than 14 days" from the last two lines and by substituting "as soon as practicable" therefor. of new section 42A.

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 42 - "Delegation. 42A. ( 1) The Majlis may delegate to any person the exercise of any power or the performance of any duty conferred or imposed on it by this Order, except for the power of delegation conferred by this section.

(2) A delegation under subsection (1) may be made subject to such may be determined by the Majlis in the instrument of delegation.

(3) The Majlis may continue to exercise any power and perform any duty conferred or imposed on it by this Order notwithstanding the delegation by it of such power or duty.". of First Schedule.

The principal Order is amended by repealing the First Schedule and by substituting the following new Schedule therefor - SCHEDULE 6(1))

UGAMA ISLAM

COUNCIL

HALAL

Thrikh: ............................... .. Date: Setiausaha Majlis Ugama Islam Secretary of the Religious Council". of Second Schedule.
The principal Order is amended by repealing the Second Schedule and by SCHEDULE 912)) of Third Schedule.

The principal Order is amended by repealing the Third Schedule and by SCHEDULE 12(1) and 43(5))

UGAMA ISLAM

COUNCIL

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM

DARUSSALAM Bah 12(1)/43(5) dari Perintah Sijil Halal dan Label Halal, 2005 of Halal Certificate and Halal Label Order; 2005 (Nama dan tempat perniagaan) (Name and place of business) adalah dibenarkan untuk menggunakan Label Halal di atas is authorised to use the Halal Label as above pada bungkusan-bungkusan ............................................. [nama makanan) on packages of ...................................................................... (name of food) SAH SEHINGGA: .......................................................................... . Tarikh: ................................ . Date: Setiausaha Majlis U gama Islam Secretary of the Religious Council". Made this 16th. day of Syaaban, 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the18th. day of August, 2008 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pemangku Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
